description: Fetch what one person did recently on other people's posts: with `type=comments`, the comments they wrote and when; with `type=reactions`, the posts they reacted to and how. Each item carries the post, with its author and counts, when they did it, and for a comment its own `comment_url`, which opens the post at that comment. The newest first, up to 100 a page, with `next_cursor` for older ones. Use this for sales signals: who a prospect engages with, and on what. Give exactly one of `url` or `vanity_name`. Costs 7 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

posted_within.description: Only comments from the last day, week or month. With `type=comments` only.

url.description: The person's public profile URL. A member-id link (`/in/ACoAA…` or `/in/ACwAA…`), as reactions and Sales Navigator give, works too.

vanity_name.description: The part after `/in/` in their public URL. A member id (`ACoAA…`) works too.

name: get_linkedin_activity
title: Get a person's LinkedIn comments and reactions
